title: Practice: Tomahawk Elbow
source: Practice Mode tutorial. The move is in the app's Technique Library (practiceData.js › Muay Thai › Tomahawk Elbow: cues, mistakes, next), named from the owner's footage by Claude; the owner corrects the name at approval. Thai: Sok Kratod (ศอกกระโดด). Footage: the owner's clip 16 (ring, 2026-10-31), raw-footage/practice/p16.mp4. One shot, no joins; three jumps facing the camera at about 1.3, 4.8 and 9.0 s and one from behind at 11.3 s.

props.description: The jumping tomahawk elbow, chopped down from above

cues.text: Drive the knee up to jump
cues.label: KNEE
cues.say: Coach: "The rear knee drives up and takes you off the floor. That's the jump."

cues.text: Elbow high at the top of the jump
cues.label: TOP
cues.say: Coach: "At the top, the elbow is already up and cocked. It comes down with you."

cues.text: Land it on the way down
cues.label: LAND
cues.say: Coach: "The strike and the landing are one motion. Your weight falls into the elbow."

watch.text: Striking before the top of the jump
watch.fix: Wait for the top, then drop it
watch.label: TOO EARLY
watch.say: Coach: "Throw it on the way up and there's nothing behind it. Peak first, then drop it."
